reaction_description: Methyl N,N-bis(tert-butoxycarbonyl)-L-phenylalaninate (1.0 equiv) and N-bromosuccinimide (2.0 equiv) were dissolved in carbon tetrachloride. The solution was irradiated with UV light at 30 C for 8 h. The corresponding beta-brominated product was obtained in 70% yield.
raw_text: Methyl N,N-bis(tert-butoxycarbonyl)-L-phenylalaninate (1.0 equiv) and N-bromosuccinimide (2.0 equiv) were dissolved in carbon tetrachloride. The solution was irradiated with UV light at 30 C for 8 h. The corresponding beta-brominated product was obtained in 70% yield.
